description: CineCat, CNO, FrameX and MoviesAPI streaming providers for Nuvio.
name: CineCat + CNO + FrameX + MoviesAPI

scrapers.description: Streams from CineCat (cinecat.eu): movies and TV via the site's own sources API — first-party HLS streams (server bengal) plus ZCDN and Aphrodite.
scrapers.name: CineCat

scrapers.description: Streams from CNO (cno.to): movies and TV via the site's own Server 21 HLS streams (up to 2160p).
scrapers.name: CNO

scrapers.description: Streams from FrameX (framextv.cc): movies and TV via the site's own stream API, pinned to the Vidly provider (Baby Dragon I HLS streams) with English subtitles.
scrapers.name: FrameX

scrapers.description: Streams from MoviesAPI (moviesapi.to): movies and TV via the site's own Vidora API, direct HLS streams.
scrapers.name: MoviesAPI
